## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC business combination and TRA execution

- 2020-11-09: Form-of TRA filed as Annex I to S-4
- 2021-02-04: Business combination closes; TRA executed by E2open Parent Holdings, E2open Holdings LLC, and TRA Parties (Insight, Elliott, PDI III, and continuing OpCo members)
- 2021-02-10: Executed TRA filed as Ex 10.2 to closing 8-K

#### WiseTech merger and TRA termination amendment

- 2025-05-25: TRA Amendment No. 1 signed concurrently with WiseTech merger agreement; fixes lump-sum settlement and terminates TRA upon merger consummation
- 2025-05-27: Amendment No. 1 filed as Ex 10.1 to merger announcement 8-K
- 2025-07-10: Q1 FY26 10-Q reclassifies entire TRA liability ($42.7M) to current; $20.7M favorable remeasurement reflects fixed settlement cap
- 2025-08-14: Form 15-12G deregistration filed (not in directory); merger close triggers TRA termination per Amendment No. 1 Section 2

## Explanation

E2open Parent Holdings entered into its Tax Receivable Agreement at the February 4, 2021 close of the Up-C-style business combination between the CC Neuberger Principal Holdings I SPAC and E2open Holdings, LLC. The contract pays 85% of realized tax benefits from Section 754 basis step-ups on exchanges of OpCo Common Units, plus the pre-existing Blocker NOLs and other Blocker tax attributes inherited at closing, and imputed-interest deductions on TRA payments. The TRA operated routinely through the BluJay and Logistyx acquisitions, with the liability moving between $50.1M and $69.7M from FY21 through FY24. On May 25, 2025 the company signed Amendment No. 1 concurrently with the WiseTech Global merger agreement: the amendment fixes a lump-sum cash settlement to TRA Parties payable at merger close, in full satisfaction of all TRA obligations, and provides that the TRA itself terminates upon consummation. The Form 15-12G filed August 14, 2025 (outside the directory) indicates the merger closed and triggered termination under Amendment No. 1 Section 2. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record and the deferred-CSV reconciliation note.
